Small worked examples with known answers

tl_fixture.Rd

  • "acceptance": a 100-minute recording with complete reference. True AF on [10, 20) and [40, 60); the detector flags [10, 20) and [70, 80), abstains on [40, 60) and otherwise answers "no AF". Under one-to-one positive-overlap matching: answer coverage 80%, answered-time sensitivity 100%, full-period capture 33.3%, episode detection 1/2, one unmatched alarm, 0.75 false alarms per answered hour, predicted burden 25% and reference burden 12.5% on answered time, and full-period predicted burden between 20% and 40%.

  • "burden_mismatch": predicted and reference AF durations are equal (20 minutes each) but never overlap, so the burden error is zero while no AF time is captured.

  • "two_detectors": detector A answers throughout; detector B declines during the hardest period. B looks better on its own answered time and captures less AF over the full period.

Usage

tl_fixture(name = c("acceptance", "burden_mismatch", "two_detectors"))

Arguments

name

Fixture name.

Details

Times are in minutes; build the ledger with time_unit = "min".

Value

A list with records, reference and predictions.

Examples

str(tl_fixture("acceptance"))
#> List of 3
#>  $ records    :Classes ‘tl_records’ and 'data.frame':	1 obs. of  6 variables:
#>   ..$ record   : chr "rec1"
#>   ..$ start    : num 0
#>   ..$ end      : num 100
#>   ..$ subject  : chr "rec1"
#>   ..$ fs       : num NA
#>   ..$ n_samples: num NA
#>  $ reference  :'data.frame':	5 obs. of  4 variables:
#>   ..$ record: chr [1:5] "rec1" "rec1" "rec1" "rec1" ...
#>   ..$ start : num [1:5] 0 10 20 40 60
#>   ..$ end   : num [1:5] 10 20 40 60 100
#>   ..$ label : chr [1:5] "non-AF" "AF" "non-AF" "AF" ...
#>  $ predictions:'data.frame':	7 obs. of  6 variables:
#>   ..$ record  : chr [1:7] "rec1" "rec1" "rec1" "rec1" ...
#>   ..$ detector: chr [1:7] "D" "D" "D" "D" ...
#>   ..$ start   : num [1:7] 0 10 20 40 60 70 80
#>   ..$ end     : num [1:7] 10 20 40 60 70 80 100
#>   ..$ response: chr [1:7] "negative" "positive" "negative" "abstain" ...
#>   ..$ reason  : chr [1:7] NA NA NA "low signal quality" ...
